title: Reporters Talk Measles, Pediatric Care, and Democrats’ Post-Election Healthcare Agenda
summary: KFF Health News journalists made the rounds on national or local media recently to discuss topical stories. Here’s a collection of their appearances.

title: Democrats Demand Answers From Oz After Delay in $50B Rural Health Awards
summary: Eighteen congressional Democrats are pressing Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services chief Mehmet Oz for answers about the $50 billion Rural Health Transformation Program after delays to states’ second-year awards. Their letter calls out an “alarming lack of public transparency.”

title: Finding an ACA Plan Have You Feeling Overwhelmed? Free Help Is Available
summary: Open enrollment season is here. “HealthQ” host Blake Farmer sits down with WAMU’s “Health Hub” to tell first-time shoppers what they need to know about picking out a health plan.

title: Big Win Sets Up Democrats To Intensify Probe of Trump’s Obamacare Purge
summary: The Trump administration canceled healthcare coverage for 760,000 enrollees in Affordable Care Act insurance plans, saying the enrollments were unauthorized. Now, with Democrats poised to take control of the House and Senate, key lawmakers want answers about the process.

title: Listen to the Latest ‘KFF Health News Minute’
summary: The "KFF Health News Minute" brings original healthcare and health policy reporting from our newsroom to the airwaves each week.

title: What’s Behind a Recent Spike in Early Social Security Claims?
summary: Experts point to well-publicized turmoil at the Social Security Administration last year as a potential spark.

title: Ahead of Thanksgiving, Readers Show Grace and Grit
summary: KFF Health News gives readers a chance to comment on a recent batch of stories.

title: Meet the Teen Who Called a Hospital Home
summary: A young survivor of gun violence lived on the third floor of a St. Louis children’s hospital, moving through the halls in a wheelchair, on and off for over three years. He said it became his home when he had nowhere safe to go.

title: Trump Administration OKs Native Traditional Healing for Two States’ Medicaid Programs
summary: The administration’s expansion of traditional healing for Native Americans comes as it shrinks Medicaid in other ways, including through restrictions that will affect access to care for an estimated 7.5 million people.

title: ‘A Hard Time’ as Federal Cuts Hobble Efforts To Stop Overdoses From Tainted Drugs
summary: Harm reduction proponents say testing street drugs prevents overdoses by allowing people to make more informed decisions about what they’re using, but the Trump administration contends that it promotes drug use.
